title: fix(dashboard): combobox filter suggestions when editing tokens
author: fisventurous
pr_body_excerpt:
fixes combobox filter suggestions when clicking a filter token so options like community are discoverable without having to type
\- pass the active draft token directly to `getModelQuerySuggestions` instead of reading the tail of the query
\- keep source suggestions enabled when editing the source filter token

closes #15078

gist.headline: Suggestions find their way
gist.blurb: Editing a dashboard filter token no longer makes its useful options vanish into the hedgerow. Click a source or community filter and the combobox brings the right choices back into view.
gist.summary: Fixed the dashboard model-filter combobox to pass the active draft token into getModelQuerySuggestions, so options such as the community source remain discoverable when editing an existing token.
gist.impact: Users can now click and edit source filter tokens while keeping source suggestions visible, without typing first to rediscover options like community.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy dashboard garden where Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, edits a glowing filter-token label on a retro terminal; a clearly visible "community" suggestion sprouts from the active token as a little code-flower. Small source-icon seed packets and gentle vines represent suggestions staying available during editing.
